name: Black Rice   Xoi Nep Than
instructions: Soak rice in enough water to cover for at least 4 hours , then drain
Place rice and the 2 cups water in a non-stick saucepan over medium heat
Reduce heat and simmer until all water is absorbed , about 40 minutes
Alternatively , place rice in a rice steamer over boiling water and cook for 40 minutes or until tender
Garnish with coconut , sesame seeds , and / or peanuts , if desired
